This is our roof, and everything starts here. Want me to show you around? It takes about a minute.
You can replay the tour any time from the ? at the top.
Your sidekick. Talk to me or type: I’ll tip you off, remind you, and even do wallet actions, but only after you confirm.
Open it and we’re off across the city roofs: jump the gaps, grab the coins, dodge the drones. Your best run hangs right here on the blue plate.
Run %d m and this clock opens today’s signature on Solana. Every signed day grows your streak, and streaks earn fee-free days. Until today is in, the sign keeps glowing.
The antenna is my phone line. When you’re busy, I pick up, note what the caller wanted and show it here. A new call sends red waves over the mast.

Each panel is an agent, an NFT in your wallet (Metaplex Core, devnet). The first one is free. Its strategy, meaning which markets it trades and how boldly, you change with one confirm. No wallet app? I’ll set up a built-in devnet wallet for you.

This board shows live prices of tokenized stocks (xStocks) from Jupiter. Tap it to buy slices of Apple or NVIDIA with $1,000 of pretend money. It’s practice: no real money, no wallet, no transactions.
The toolbox: wallet, language, my voice, the secretary. Lost? Tap ☰ for the full list, or ? to replay this tour.
A daily game for Solana phones: run the roofs, sign your day on-chain, and let AI agents and a phone secretary work while you’re busy. Everything here runs on devnet.
%d m of running unlocks the day’s signature: a devnet memo transaction through Mobile Wallet Adapter or the built-in wallet. A streak of signed days earns fee-free windows.
Every agent is a Metaplex Core NFT. A free mint and a 0.1 SOL Pro purchase, both real devnet transactions:
For judges without Phantom or Solflare: a built-in devnet wallet. The key is sealed in Android Keystore and topped up from a faucet:
Sol answers calls for you and saves the gist as a short note. Unread calls light up the antenna.
Say “start Weather Station” and Sol checks it, then shows a card with the SOL price. Nothing is sent until you tap.
Slice prices are live (Jupiter), but the portfolio is paper. Agents’ paper trades are simulated and marked that way. Only what you confirm goes on-chain.
